definitions.gloss: holding in a collection; storing (in a museum or library)
definitions.explanation: Keeping works, documents or specimens as part of a collection, as a museum, library or archive does.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名画|めいが}→名画：17385_meiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{収蔵|しゅうぞう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{収蔵|しゅうぞう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Most of a museum's collection is usually kept in storage rather than on display.

notes:
Formal; used of museums, libraries and archives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {収蔵品|しゅうぞうひん}: items in a collection
- ⟦{収蔵庫|しゅうぞうこ}→収蔵庫：22858_shuuzouko⟧: storage vault
- {収蔵|しゅうぞう}⟦{点数|てんすう}→点数：04543_tensuu⟧: number of items held

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{所蔵|しょぞう}→所蔵：12889_shozou⟧: to own and hold; common in captions ({東京国立博物館|とうきょうこくりつはくぶつかん}⟦{所蔵|しょぞう}→所蔵：12889_shozou⟧: in the collection of the Tokyo National Museum). {収蔵|しゅうぞう} stresses taking items in and storing them
